integrity: Analytic polynomial integration, branch monotonicity and quadratic-discriminant proof; finite checker is corroborative, not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Only the lateral surface of a finite, nondegenerate right circular cone; independent surface-area-uniform points and ambient Euclidean chords. Exact population even moments, not finite-sample statistics. General density-moment literature not fully accessible; historical originality provisional.
title: Sharp chord-moment ambiguity and stable reconstruction of circular cone sidewalls
